name: Socialdemokraterna / Mona Sahlin (2010 joint S-MP-V motion)
detail: Motion 2009/10:Fi15 says reintroducing the old wealth tax in its earlier form is "inte helt realistiskt" and proposes a study of how tax on the wealthy can rise by about SEK 4bn. No wealth tax is named as a goal.

name: Niklas Karlsson m.fl. (S), motion 2022/23:2138
detail: Says the abolished wealth tax had a progressive distributional profile, and that the best-off should contribute more, but does not ask for a wealth tax.

name: Ida Gabrielsson (V)
detail: TV4 2026-05-18 quotes her as saying that whoever has most must contribute a little more; no wealth tax named in her own words. Covered through the party and the motion signatories.

name: Ameer Sachet (S), motion 2009/10:Sk342
detail: Calls for a wealth tax but was submitted in autumn 2009, before the 2010-01-01 window. Check for later statements.

name: Carl Schlyter (MP), motion 2017/18:2107
detail: "Ökade förmögenhetsskatter, arvsskatter samt marginalskatter" is rational, in a motion on top salaries. Already recorded through the 2017/18:2962 motion; keep as a possible second evidence row.

name: Förmögenhetsregister / förmögenhetsdeklaration motions (V, S 2013-2025)
detail: Motions asking for wealth statistics or a wealth declaration (e.g. 2013/14:Fi274 by S, 2020/21:2299 and 2021/22:2597 by V) are about information, not a tax.
